title: ZIP preflight before any decompression
summary: Audit metadata limits and path safety before CRC or member decompression to resist archive expansion attacks.
invariants: Do not call ZipFile.testzip or read archived members before metadata gates.
Reject traversal, absolute/drive paths, casefold duplicates, symlinks, unsupported compression and encrypted entries.
Bound per-member and cumulative decompression when integrity checking.
An audit PASS is only ZIP structural/integrity evidence, never a license/security/source-quality approval.
procedure: Run python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v in packages/oorexx-dbus-qualification.
Run python3 tools/audit_archive.py /path/to/candidate.zip and retain JSON.
When metadata rejects, mark integrity NOT_RUN, not PASS.
When preflight accepts, CRC-check via bounded streaming and record errors.
